title: EXCITABLE GLASS
description: A discrete excitable medium sends wave fronts through refractory state, but the coarse simulation is never shown directly. A full-resolution glass material reconstructs pressure fronts, relief and caustic edges. Touch intelligently ignites quiet material or quenches active material.

visual_finish.composition: overlapping autonomous wave fronts cross a dark glass plate with large calm fields between events
visual_finish.material_model: thick illuminated glass with refractory colour memory, caustic front edges and fine etched grain
